title: Opposite-arc esses transition and recovery
description: Two opposite 60-degree arcs of 65 m radius with a 25 m/s entry from BENCHMARKS.md 'Handling fixtures' (Esses row), covering transition and recovery. The linking straight, approach/exit lengths and road width are authored initial values; BENCHMARKS specifies the arcs, radius and entry speed. A reporting metric is carried because BENCHMARKS asks for esses deltas to be reported.

Opposite direction to segment 1; arc length 68.0678 m.

car.balanced_starter is the fixed ID of the balanced starter (Comet) from BENCHMARKS; the Sparrow and Slidewinder IDs are working names until the M1 car registry assigns stable IDs.

The per-car handling resource (../handling_config.schema.json) is M1 work; the revision this fixture targets is undetermined until M1 assigns it. BENCHMARKS regenerates reference records when handling dependencies change, so the fixture records the target revision instead of duplicating coefficients.
